name:
Code Name: S.T.E.A.M.:
Update
description:
An update for "Code Name: S.T.E.A.M." is now available from Nintendo eShop.

All customers who own a copy of “Code Name: S.T.E.A.M.” should download the update.

This will update the software to Version 1.2.0 with the following amendments:

- Various bugs have been fixed in order to provide a smoother gaming experience.
disclaimer:
You may need to upgrade your current SD Card to a compatible SDHC Card or microSDHC Card with enough available space to download this software.
Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
descriptors: Online Interactions Not Rated by the ESRB
